description: Dated evidence additions for JTC 5 cooperation, jurisdictional policy and public programmes, W3C technical connections and the planned European Product Act. batches.description: Dated additive evidence update for JTC 5 committee cooperation and the nine organisations in its Category A liaison register. The frozen release remains unchanged.
UK policy evidence update: two sector consultations and sourced connections for the existing Great Britain DPR consultation. Policy discussion is distinguished from enacted passport duties.
Primary-source additions for Switzerland’s THG proposal, Norway’s battery-registry consultation and Taiwan’s resource-circulation law and voluntary DPP pilot.

Dated W3C connections: EN 18219 normative references, W3C task-force discussion touching JTC 5 and JTC 24, and specification stewardship. Formal liaison, discussion and normative reference remain distinct.
Dated technical relationships connecting the UNTP working profile and CIRPASS-2 ontology to W3C standards. These are specification relationships, not claims of national adoption.
Adds the planned European Product Act product-rules reform and its sourced ESPR and battery-passport context; no leaked provisions or new current duties are asserted.
Adds two official readiness records for Egypt and Bangladesh. Supports qualified early public-programme and exporter-guidance profiles; no new passport mandates are asserted.

relationship_definitions.coordinates_with: Source-announced committee cooperation. Does not imply adoption, equivalence, mutual recognition or completed interoperability.
relationship_definitions.liaison_with: An organisation listed in a committee liaison register. The Category A designation is retained in the assertion and locator; no technical use or semantic compatibility is inferred.
relationship_definitions.references: An explicit source reference or contextual discussion; it does not establish legal incorporation, conformity, standard adoption or mutual recognition.
relationship_definitions.part_of: A provision, document or activity identified within its named instrument, programme or group; legal scope, publication status and maturity remain qualified in the records.
relationship_definitions.developed_by: The group identified by the primary source as developing or publishing the document; the document status is retained.
relationship_definitions.normatively_references: The cited document is explicitly listed in normative references. Applicable clauses and implementation choices still determine the requirements; universal implementation or interoperability is not inferred.
relationship_definitions.uses_standard: The inspected specification or documentation explicitly uses the linked standard for the stated technical purpose. Scope, version and maturity qualifications remain attached; this is not proof of implementation conformance, legal adoption or interoperability.

status.scope_note: Consultation 2026/4456 closed on 11 May 2026. Subsequent adoption and current Norwegian applicability were not established by this source.

limitations: The source records a proposal and an expired consultation, not final enactment or EEA incorporation.

entities.label: Taiwan
entities.description: Geographic join for the assessed Taiwanese legal framework and voluntary DPP pilot.

geography.join_note: TWN is used solely to join the assessed records to the existing map boundary dataset; the map is a geographic research index.

status.scope_note: Geographic research scope only; the presence of a record does not establish a universal DPP obligation.

entities.label: Taiwan Resource Circulation Promotion Act
entities.description: The amended Act establishes a resource-circulation framework including powers for product-information disclosure under Article 22.

status.scope_note: Amended on 17 June 2026. Article 52 brings the Act into force on promulgation, except Article 14 and Article 38(1), which take effect two years later.

dates.condition: Article 14 and Article 38(1), two years after promulgation.

limitations: The Act is an enabling framework; designated products, disclosure methods and deadlines require the relevant announcements and rules.
This record does not establish a general mandatory DPP rollout or a single DPP compliance date.
The official English translation states that the Chinese text prevails in case of discrepancy.

entities.label: Taiwan product-information disclosure: Article 22
entities.description: Article 22 enables designated products to carry material, repairability and circularity information; where a unique product code is used, traceability and quality-verification information must be updated.

status.scope_note: The authority must specify covered products, deadlines and methods. Products outside those designations may disclose information voluntarily.

dates.condition: Article 52; product-specific duties depend on implementing announcements.

limitations: No product-specific designation or implementing disclosure rule was verified for this update.
Article 22 does not itself prescribe W3C, UNTP or a particular DPP data model.

entities.label: Taiwan voluntary DPP pilot programme
entities.description: The Resource Circulation Administration reports a voluntary programme across batteries, textiles, ICT equipment and circular materials, alongside an open-source module and cross-border data-exchange testing.

status.scope_note: The 7 September 2026 agency report describes 28 participating companies and more than 20,000 product records. This is pilot evidence, not nationwide compliance.

limitations: Reported pilot results were not independently reproduced.
Cross-border tests do not establish formal mutual recognition, EU conformity or adoption of a named international technical standard.
The source places the pilot alongside Article 22 but does not establish a universal domestic DPP duty.

entities.label: W3C DPP discussion with JTC 5 / JTC 24 context
entities.description: W3C task-force discussion of verifiable credentials and DPP schemas, with participant-reported JTC 24 work and planned JTC 5 work.

status.scope_note: Discussion evidence, not a formal liaison, committee decision or adoption of W3C standards.

limitations: Participant affiliation is self-reported in a transcript; this does not establish institutional representation.

entities.label: W3C JSON-LD 1.1
entities.description: JSON syntax for expressing linked data and shared term identifiers.

status.scope_note: Global web standard; use alone does not establish DPP compliance.

limitations: Serialization format; does not itself prescribe a product vocabulary or access policy.

entities.label: W3C OWL 2
entities.description: Ontology language for describing classes, properties and formal relationships.

status.scope_note: Global ontology language; applications choose applicable profiles and semantics.

limitations: The overview is informative; no particular OWL profile is inferred for a connected implementation.

entities.label: W3C SHACL
entities.description: Language for checking RDF data against explicitly supplied shapes.

status.scope_note: Validation rules apply to specified data and shapes; this does not define a universal closed-world ontology.

limitations: A SHACL relationship does not imply that every shape is closed or that an entire ecosystem uses closed-world semantics.

entities.label: European Product Act — planned product-rules reform
entities.description: Planned EU reform of horizontal product rules and market surveillance. The Commission is examining a horizontal DPP tool that can use ESPR infrastructure.

status.scope_note: The Commission tracker, updated 7 October, still lists the NLF and market-surveillance reform as planned. A formally published product-rules proposal was not established in this review.

limitations: This is a policy initiative, not adopted EU law or a current horizontal DPP duty. Product coverage, obligations and commencement remain unsettled.

The wider package originally also included standardisation reform. The tracker separately records that standardisation proposal on 6 October 2026; that does not mean this product-rules reform has been adopted.
Connections below record policy context and intended compatibility, not legal incorporation or proof that ESPR is replaced. No leaked-draft provisions are treated as requirements.

entities.label: Egypt GOEIC digital product-traceability programme
entities.description: Public digital inspection and product-traceability programme announced by Egypt's GOEIC with Korean support. Its planned 2025–2029 components include a DPP system for locally manufactured industrial products.

status.scope_note: March 2025 official announcement describes a June 2025–end-2029 project schedule. Current delivery, deployment and compulsory passport requirements were not established.

limitations: A public implementation programme is not itself a legal passport obligation.
Planned system components do not establish a completed or deployed platform. No organisational link to the separate UNIDO textile pilot procurement is asserted.
The official indexed text was inspected; direct page retrieval timed out.

status.scope_note: Government-portal publication about EU market access; not a domestic Bangladeshi DPP instrument. Publication date is not stated.

limitations: Official publication of exporter guidance does not establish adoption of a domestic passport law, national strategy or mandatory platform.
The article reports industry statements and calls for support; these are not treated as adopted government policy.

navigation_groups.description: W3C standards and vocabulary work together with their documented DPP uses and discussion context. Includes EN 18219, UNTP working specifications and CIRPASS-2. Published Recommendations, drafts, references and discussion retain distinct statuses; related records are not W3C members.

JTC 5, its two work items, cooperation with JTC 24 and nine listed Category A liaison organisations. W3C appears through task-force discussion and the JTC 24 / EN 18219 standards path. No formal W3C liaison or JTC 5 adoption of W3C technology is established.

European DPP standards and their documented W3C context: EN 18219 normatively references DID Core and VC 2.0. Includes committee cooperation and a separate task-force discussion. A normative reference does not mandate every technology in every DPP.

UNTP initiative and versioned specifications, with their documented W3C dependencies. New technical edges describe the current pre-production working profile, not the separate maintained 0.7.0 release or national adoption.

CIRPASS-2 programme and research artifacts, with OWL 2 ontology structure, separate SHACL validation profiles and its input to W3C DPP vocabulary work. Research connections do not establish EU endorsement or successful implementation.
